edges.reason: The Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
pause() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which checks msg.sender against owner.
unpause() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which checks msg.sender against owner.
setNewAddress is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
changeCommission is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawCommission is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner modifier.
requestAudit uses msg.sender and msg.value to build the request key and accumulate the reward.
withdrawRequest derives the request key from msg.sender and sends Ether back to msg.sender.
auditContract keys the reward on msg.sender and transfers the reward to msg.sender.
expireDate is computed from now, so the request lifetime depends on the block timestamp.
require(now > request.expireDate) lets the miner-controlled timestamp decide refund eligibility.
requestAudit reads and increases rewards[hashAuditorCode] with msg.value.
requestAudit reads auditOutcomes to ensure the contract is not already audited.
requestAudit creates or updates the AuditRequest entry in auditRequests.
requestAudit increases totalRequestsAmount by msg.value.
requestAudit uses SafeMath.add for reward accumulation and expiration date.
withdrawRequest subtracts the refunded amount from rewards[hashAuditorCode].
withdrawRequest reads auditOutcomes to block withdrawals of already audited contracts.
withdrawRequest deletes amount and expireDate on the stored AuditRequest.
withdrawRequest decreases totalRequestsAmount by the refunded amount.
withdrawRequest uses SafeMath.sub for reward and total bookkeeping.
withdrawRequest performs an external msg.sender.transfer immediately after mutating state.
auditContract writes the APPROVED or REJECTED outcome into auditOutcomes.
auditContract reads rewards[hashAuditorCode] as the reward to be paid out.
auditContract decreases totalRequestsAmount by the paid reward.
auditContract writes the freshly calculated commission into the commission state variable.
auditContract increases availableCommission by the computed commission.
auditContract calls calcCommission to determine the service fee.
auditContract ends with an external msg.sender.transfer of the net reward.
auditContract uses SafeMath.sub for totalRequestsAmount and reward minus commission.
calcCommission reads the commission percentage to compute the fee.
calcCommission multiplies the amount by the commission using SafeMath.mul.
calcCommission produces an arithmetic result from _amount and commission that drives payouts.
changeCommission writes the new percentage into the commission state variable.
withdrawCommission decreases availableCommission before the payout.
withdrawCommission finishes with an external msg.sender.transfer to the owner.
withdrawCommission uses SafeMath.sub to reduce availableCommission.
setNewAddress writes the validated _v2Address into newContractAddress.
transferOwnership assigns newOwner to the owner state variable.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
unpause sets the paused flag back to false.
The SolidStamp unpause override requires newContractAddress to be the zero address before unpausing.
The external transfer in withdrawRequest sends Ether to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
The external transfer in auditContract sends Ether to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
The external transfer in withdrawCommission sends Ether to the owner (msg.sender).
Direct payments from msg.sender hit the fallback function which reverts.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter is only used inside transferOwnership to set the owner, so its semantics belong to that function.
The parameter is only an input of setNewAddress and is stored in newContractAddress there.
The auditor address participates in the request keys and event data of requestAudit only.
The code hash is combined with the auditor and caller addresses when building the request keys.
The audit duration is range-checked and added to now inside requestAudit.
The auditor address is only used to reconstruct the keys identifying the request to refund.
The code hash is only used to rebuild the reward and request keys during withdrawal.
The code hash only contributes to the auditor/code key used by auditContract.
The approval flag only selects the outcome value stored by auditContract.
The new percentage is validated and written to commission exclusively by changeCommission.
The amount is the sole operand, aside from the commission state variable, of the fee computation.
The amount is bounded by availableCommission and transferred within withdrawCommission.
Temporary key deriving rewards and auditOutcomes entries within requestAudit.
Locally cached auditOutcomes value used for the NOT_AUDITED guard in requestAudit.
Intermediate value of the rewards mapping accumulation inside requestAudit.
Timestamp derived value stored into the AuditRequest struct by requestAudit.
Key computed from the auditor, caller and code hash to index auditRequests in requestAudit.
Storage pointer that requestAudit creates or tops up in auditRequests.
Key used by withdrawRequest to check outcomes and reduce rewards.
Locally read auditOutcomes value guarding the refund in withdrawRequest.
Key locating the caller request inside auditRequests during withdrawal.
Storage pointer whose fields are validated and deleted by withdrawRequest.
The cached request amount is exactly the value passed to the external transfer to msg.sender.
Key computed from msg.sender and the code hash to read and write auditor records.
Locally read auditOutcomes value enforcing the single-audit rule in auditContract.
The cached reward is split into commission and the amount sent to msg.sender by the external transfer.
